allowed_actions.AFFIRM: User agrees or approves prior suggestion.
allowed_actions.DEEPEN: User asks for deeper research or reasoning.
allowed_actions.RETRY: User asks to redo or try again.
allowed_actions.TRANSFORM: User asks to revise active output.
allowed_actions.CORRECT: User corrects prior context or answer.
allowed_actions.CONTINUE: User asks to continue workflow or perform an action on active work.

rules: Only use active_task as the target for follow-up transformations.
Do not treat older recent_turns as active instructions.
Default to standalone interpretation unless the user clearly refers back to active_task.
If follow-up is true, resolved_text must include the relevant previous user request and/or assistant answer.
If there is not enough prior context, be conservative and mark standalone or low confidence.
